[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 44, "var": "static_data", "code": "memcpy(static_data, data, size);", "note": "Attacker-controlled input of 32768 bytes is copied into the 32768-byte global static_data buffer, filling it completely."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 46, "var": "config", "code": "config = config_open_for_fuzzing(static_data, size);", "note": "Config parser initialized with static_data and size 32768; lexer.end set to static_data + 32767 (last valid byte)."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "config_open_for_fuzzing", "line": 772, "var": "lexer.end", "code": "return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);", "note": "lexer.end points to the last byte of the 32768-byte global buffer; any read past this is out of bounds."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "parse_config", "line": 648, "var": "lexeme", "code": "if (!lex_next(&parser->lexer, &lexeme)) return NULL;", "note": "parse_config calls lex_next; the first character '=' produces LEXEME_EQUAL."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "parse_config", "line": 650, "var": "lexeme->type", "code": "case LEXEME_EQUAL: return parse_key_value;", "note": "The '=' character causes parse_config to transition to parse_key_value."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "parse_key_value", "line": 520, "var": "lexer", "code": "while (lex_next(&parser->lexer, &lexeme))", "note": "parse_key_value calls lex_next to process the value; the next input is ''' which triggers lex_multiline_string."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_config", "line": 458, "var": "chr", "code": "if (chr == '\\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"''\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;", "note": "Input contains ''' so lex_config detects a multiline string and transitions to lex_multiline_string."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 339, "var": "end", "code": "char *end = (peek(lexer) == '\"') ? \"\\\"\\\"\\\"\" : \"'''\";", "note": "peek() returns the second quote character, so the closing delimiter is set to '''."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 342, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "advance_n(lexer, strlen(\"'''\") - 1);", "note": "pos advances past the opening ''' to index 4; the remaining bytes are all 'a' with no closing ''' delimiter."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 345, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3))", "note": "Loop scans for closing ''' but never finds it; pos advances through the buffer via next()."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 345, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3))", "note": "When pos reaches the last valid byte (static_data[32767]), strncmp reads 3 bytes: static_data[32767], static_data[32768], static_data[32769]. The latter two are past the 32768-byte global buffer."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 345, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)", "note": "GLOBAL-BUFFER-OVERFLOW READ: strncmp reads bytes beyond the end of the global static_data buffer, triggering ASAN."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON, steps:', len(data))"` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now let me update the trace for this new PoC and submit it. The flow is:
1. Input starts with `=` → `parse_config` sees `LEXEME_EQUAL` → enters `parse_key_value`
2. `parse_key_value` calls `lex_next` → `lex_config` sees `'''` → `lex_multiline_string`
3. `lex_multiline_string` scans for closing `'''` but never finds it
4. When `pos` reaches the end of the buffer, `strncmp` reads past the global buffer → ASAN overflow
